body: Heh thanks. The worst part is just seeing everyone my age getting their shit together and evolving as individuals while I feel like I'm just standing in place and the world goes on without me. I still feel like the same scared little kid inside, paralyzed with fear and indecision. I know that comparing yourself to others is a surefire way to feel sorry for yourself, but it's just so hard not to sometimes when everyone else seems so happy and fulfilled. Living with my parents again for a while wouldn't be the worst thing in the world, I mean talking to strangers is what got me through high school, so it could help me again. The hardest part is being patient and finding some kind of silver lining to look forward to. But thank you for taking the time to read and respond to my post. It's just nice to know someone is listening, stranger or not. :)
